title: New econ unit test passes vacuously when catalog load fails (bare return on error path)
detail: The anti-vacuity guard itself has an unhandled error path: load failure exits via bare return, so odin test records a PASS with zero assertions executed.
recommended_fix: Fail the test on load error instead of returning: testing.errorf(t, "econ unit: catalog load failed: %s", e) (or t.fatalf) so a broken data/ path cannot ship the guard green.

title: dot_interval ceiling boundary pinned only on reject side; last-valid value 20000 has no accept test
detail: Only first-invalid (20001) is tested; no row loads dot_interval_ticks=20000, so a validator mutation > to >= stays green while wrongly rejecting the boundary value.
recommended_fix: Add an accept-side row: assert catalogs_load succeeds with dot_interval_ticks=20000 (BAL_VALID with 2400 replaced by 20000), pinning the inclusive upper bound.

title: demand.json _comment corrupted by the edit: duplicated garbled ruling fragment
evidence: the shipped app starts at Foundations (era 1, USER RULING 20the shipped app starts at Foundations (era 1, USER RULING 2026-08-28) and advances via the 6.2 gate; the era-3 plans fire when the run reaches the Streaming Surge.
detail: The comment edit spliced mid-token, duplicating the ruling sentence; JSON still parses so no loader or test catches the corrupted canon text riding the PR.

title: Tautological sanity assertion in new econ unit test (i32 >= 0 can never fail)
detail: stats.crises is an i32 incremented from zero, so >= 0 is always true — the branch is dead and verifies nothing about the scenario run.
recommended_fix: Delete the tautology, or assert a meaningful bound (e.g. stats.crises == 0 for an era-2 brush run, matching the era-2 scenario's no-crisis shape).
